title: Whale Peek-a-Boo: Ollie rides in the boat
kaylee: Ollie hops into Maple's boat and rides in the front, instead of being towed behind it. Nothing on her tummy until the baby orca gives her rock back.

pictures.title: The game
pictures.caption: Before: towed on a rope, a clam on her tummy that looked like her lost rock. After: on her back in the front of the boat, tummy empty.

pictures.title: The film's last beat ("Hop on!")
pictures.caption: Before: she grabs the rope. After: she swims up, splashes, hops into the front, and the game starts with her there.

pictures.title: Riding the humpback
pictures.caption: She rides along in the boat on the whale's back.

pictures.title: The rock comes back
pictures.caption: The first time anything is on her tummy: the rock from the baby orca.
